# @lyndon/ui

> Animated React 19 components in the shadcn style: Tailwind CSS (v4 or v3) for styling, motion for animation, themes as
> CSS variables (seven palette families, light and dark). Forms, overlays, navigation, data grid, charts, diagrams, maps,
> media, AI chat and agent UIs. Every component is also a self-contained .tsx drop-in file.

Version 0.6.0. Source: https://github.com/lantos1618/oneshot-ui. Docs: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/. Licence: MIT with a revenue threshold (free up to USD 200k ARR).

## Use it

- Install: `npm i @lyndon/ui motion` (peer deps react@19, react-dom@19). Import from `@lyndon/ui` or a subpath (`@lyndon/ui/charts`).
- Styles: Tailwind v4 `@source "../node_modules/@lyndon/ui/dist";`, or without Tailwind `import '@lyndon/ui/styles.css'`.
- Wrap the app once in `<UIProvider>`: it injects the theme tokens, applies the theme (light/dark/system), hosts toasts.
- Colours only through tokens: `bg-[var(--card)]`, `text-[var(--fg2)]`, `border-[var(--line)]`, `var(--accent)`, `var(--ok|warn|bad)`. Override a component's class with Tailwind's `!` prefix.
- Strict CSP: `<UIProvider injectStyles={false}>` plus `import '@lyndon/ui/tokens.css'`, or pass `nonce`.

## Drop-in files (for AI chats and copy-paste)

Each file below is one component (or a small family) with exactly the helpers it needs, importing only react, react-dom
and motion. Attach the ones you need plus ui-provider.tsx; they share one UIProvider. Sizes are approximate tokens.

- CLI (offline, from the installed package): `npx @lyndon/ui add data-grid dialog --dir src/components/ui`, `npx @lyndon/ui list`, `npx @lyndon/ui info data-grid`
- shadcn CLI: `npx shadcn add https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/r/data-grid.json` (pulls in ui-provider)
- Index with sizes, exports and embedded components: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/index.json
- The same files from npm: https://unpkg.com/@lyndon/ui@0.6.0/dist-registry/files/<name>.tsx
- Whole library in one file (dist-single/ui-all.tsx, ~589.9k tokens): only for tools with a very large context; prefer the drop-ins

## Foundation

- [hooks](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/hooks.tsx): Shared hooks: controlled-or-uncontrolled state, outside clicks, disclosure, element size, media queries, pointer drags, long press, hotkeys, focus trap, roving focus, streamed text and scroll edges. (~8.4k tokens)
- [locale-provider](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/locale-provider.tsx): Provides the locale to everything below (UIProvider renders one; use it directly to localise one subtree). (~7.2k tokens)
- [messages-ar](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/messages-ar.tsx): Arabic strings for the built-in UI (right to left from the locale): <UIProvider locale="ar-EG" messages={UI_MESSAGES_AR}>. (~2.2k tokens)
- [messages-de](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/messages-de.tsx): German strings for the built-in UI: <UIProvider locale="de-DE" messages={UI_MESSAGES_DE}>. (~1.9k tokens)
- [motion](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/motion.tsx): Reveal on scroll, useViewport (pause work off screen), frame loops, tweens, play/shake keyframes and motion presets. (~2.1k tokens)
- [ui-hosts](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/ui-hosts.tsx): Renders the registered hosts (UIProvider includes it). (~801 tokens)
- [ui-provider](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/ui-provider.tsx): Wrap your app once: injects the theme tokens (CSS variables), applies and saves the theme (light, dark, system, seven palettes), provides the locale (English strings; add messages-de / messages-ar for those), hosts page-level UI such as the toast region and turns motion off for reduced-motion users. (~19.8k tokens)
- [utils](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/utils.tsx): Pure helpers: cn() and variants() for class names, spring() for motion, safeUrl/safeColor for model output, number and date formatting, clamp, mix and contrast. (~5.0k tokens)

## Primitives

- [animated-number](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/animated-number.tsx): Rolling number (replaces the NumberFlow web component): each digit rolls to its new value. (~3.1k tokens)
- [avatar](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/avatar.tsx): Avatar from @lyndon/ui. (~3.3k tokens)
- [badge](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/badge.tsx): Status pill, tag or count: the one badge primitive. (~2.7k tokens)
- [button](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/button.tsx): Every button presses down slightly (scale .96), like the original page. (~6.2k tokens)
- [card](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/card.tsx): Surface for grouping content. (~624 tokens)
- [chip](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/chip.tsx): Pill button for filters, toggles and suggestions. (~2.2k tokens)
- [icon](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/icon.tsx): Every icon (inline SVG paths) and <Icon>. (~3.4k tokens)
- [kbd](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/kbd.tsx): A key or shortcut ("⌘K", "Esc"). (~458 tokens)
- [scroll-edges](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/scroll-edges.tsx): Edge fades for a horizontal scroller, plus (on touch screens, until the first scroll) a small "swipe for more" pill on the end side (right in LTR, left in RTL). (~3.9k tokens)
- [skeleton](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/skeleton.tsx): Loading placeholder with a shimmer sweep (paused while off screen; off for reduced motion). (~652 tokens)
- [slot](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/slot.tsx): Renders its single child with its own props merged in (see the asChild contract above). (~1.3k tokens)
- [spark-chart](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/spark-chart.tsx): Word-sized chart for tables and tiles. (~2.5k tokens)
- [spinner](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/spinner.tsx): Spinning ring (role=status, "Loading" in the provider's language). (~2.3k tokens)
- [status-icon](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/status-icon.tsx): Round step/status marker for steppers, checks and task lists: done (filled tick, pops in), failed (filled ✕), active (spinning ring, or the step `number` in a bold ring), pending (grey ring, with `number` if given). (~2.5k tokens)

## Forms and inputs

- [calendar](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/calendar.tsx): Month grid (an ARIA grid; day cells grow to 40×40 on touch). (~16.2k tokens)
- [checkbox](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/checkbox.tsx): Checkbox with a drawn checkmark; `children` is its label. (~4.3k tokens)
- [color-picker](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/color-picker.tsx): Swatches, a hue slider and a hex field. (~19.8k tokens)
- [combobox](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/combobox.tsx): Type to filter (the match is bolded), arrows to move, Enter to choose. (~27.2k tokens)
- [currency-input](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/currency-input.tsx): Amount field: thousands separators appear while you type, using the currency's locale (1’234.50 CHF, 1.234,50 EUR…), at most two decimals. (~9.1k tokens)
- [date-field](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/date-field.tsx): Typed date entry: day, month and year segments in the locale's order, separators and digits (en-GB dd/mm/yyyy, en-US mm/dd/yyyy, de-DE tt.mm.jjjj, ja-JP yyyy/mm/dd). (~15.5k tokens)
- [date-picker](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/date-picker.tsx): Date field: the calendar pops from the field (keyboard ready), the picked day pops, Today and Clear sit under the grid. (~28.4k tokens)
- [date-range-picker](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/date-range-picker.tsx): Range picker with presets (the matching preset stays highlighted; presets that fall outside `min`/`max` or start or end on an unavailable day are disabled). (~29.2k tokens)
- [date-time-field](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/date-time-field.tsx): Typed date and time in one field: the locale's date segments, then hour, minute (second) and am/pm, then the time zone's short name. (~17.7k tokens)
- [date-time-picker](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/date-time-picker.tsx): Date and time picker: a DateTimeField with a calendar button (or Alt+↓) opening the Calendar with a TimeField under it, and with `timeZonePicker` a searchable time-zone picker beside it. (~39.1k tokens)
- [file-upload](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/file-upload.tsx): Drop zone + file list. (~14.1k tokens)
- [form](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/form.tsx): A <form> that validates its fields and shows the messages in its FormFields, with no form library. (~8.4k tokens)
- [inline-date-picker](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/inline-date-picker.tsx): Inline date picker card with two modes: one date, or a range. (~33.2k tokens)
- [input](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/input.tsx): Text input. (~1.8k tokens)
- [month-picker](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/month-picker.tsx): Month and year picker: a field that opens a grid of months (its title opens a grid of years), in the locale. (~20.2k tokens)
- [multi-select](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/multi-select.tsx): Pick several: ticks draw in the list, chosen items become chips (with their colour dot) in the field. (~29.0k tokens)
- [number-stepper](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/number-stepper.tsx): − value + with a rolling number. (~10.7k tokens)
- [otp-input](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/otp-input.tsx): One-time code: auto-advance, paste fills every box, typing into a filled box replaces and re-pops it. (~9.1k tokens)
- [password-input](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/password-input.tsx): Password with show/hide (the eye pops when it flips). (~11.1k tokens)
- [phone-input](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/phone-input.tsx): Phone number with a country picker (flags and dial codes). (~25.5k tokens)
- [radio-group](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/radio-group.tsx): Radio group with arrow-key navigation. (~6.7k tokens)
- [rating](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/rating.tsx): 1–5 stars: every lit star pops again in sequence on each pick. (~9.6k tokens)
- [segmented-control](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/segmented-control.tsx): Segmented control with a sliding pill: a single choice, so it is a radiogroup (role=radio + aria-checked). (~7.6k tokens)
- [select](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/select.tsx): Custom select: arrows, Enter/Space, type-ahead that cycles through options starting with the typed letter (works closed too), springs open, flips upward near the bottom of the viewport, checkmark on the current option. (~22.8k tokens)
- [slider](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/slider.tsx): Range slider with live value. (~22.0k tokens)
- [switch](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/switch.tsx): Toggle. (~5.1k tokens)
- [tag-input](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/tag-input.tsx): Type and press Enter (or comma) to add; Backspace on empty removes the last tag. (~8.3k tokens)
- [textarea](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/textarea.tsx): Auto-growing textarea; the height animates as lines are added or removed. (~7.2k tokens)
- [time-field](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/time-field.tsx): Typed time entry: hour and minute (and second) segments, with an am/pm segment on a 12-hour clock (from the locale or `hourCycle`); type "930" or "9" then ":" and "30", ↑/↓ step a segment, "a"/"p" sets am/pm, pasting "14:30" or "2:30 PM" fills it. (~21.1k tokens)
- [time-picker](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/time-picker.tsx): Time picker: a TimeField (type the time, or step it with ↑/↓) plus a clock button listing times every `step` minutes (15) between `from` and `to` (07:00 to 21:00), opening scrolled to the current one. (~21.2k tokens)
- [time-zone-picker](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/time-zone-picker.tsx): Searchable time-zone picker: a Combobox of `Intl.supportedValuesOf('timeZone')` (about 420 zones, virtualised), labelled with their current offset, "(GMT+01:00) Europe/Zurich", and sorted by it; type a city or "GMT+05". (~30.5k tokens)
- [year-picker](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/year-picker.tsx): Year picker: a field that opens a grid of twelve years (arrows page past the edges). (~18.9k tokens)

## Overlays

- [alert-dialog](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/alert-dialog.tsx): Confirmation for a consequential action (role="alertdialog"). (~15.1k tokens)
- [command-palette](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/command-palette.tsx): ⌘K palette: type to filter (every word must match the label, keywords or hint), arrows to move, Enter to run. (~22.2k tokens)
- [context-menu](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/context-menu.tsx): Right-click, long-press (touch) or press the Menu key / Shift+F10 on the focused area to open a menu at that point. (~17.2k tokens)
- [dialog](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/dialog.tsx): Modal dialog. (~11.5k tokens)
- [dropdown-menu](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/dropdown-menu.tsx): <DropdownMenu trigger="Options"><MenuItem shortcut="E">Edit</MenuItem>…</DropdownMenu> Opens with click, Enter or ↓; the first item takes focus and the rest stagger in. (~17.7k tokens)
- [hover-card](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/hover-card.tsx): Rich preview on hover or focus (profiles, links, citations). (~8.8k tokens)
- [inline-edit](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/inline-edit.tsx): Click (or Enter) to edit; Enter or blur saves, Escape cancels. (~7.4k tokens)
- [notification-bell](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/notification-bell.tsx): Bell with an unread count; shakes when new unread items arrive. (~16.2k tokens)
- [popover](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/popover.tsx): Anchored panel: `<Popover><PopoverTrigger>Share</PopoverTrigger><PopoverContent>…</PopoverContent></Popover>`, or the parts `Popover.Root` / `Popover.Trigger` (asChild) / `Popover.Content` (side, align, sideOffset, arrow) / `Popover.Close`. (~9.5k tokens)
- [sheet](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/sheet.tsx): Panel that slides in from an edge: `side` is `end` (default; the right in LTR, the left in RTL), `start`, the physical `left`/`right`, or `bottom`. (~12.5k tokens)
- [tooltip](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/tooltip.tsx): Short delay, quick fade. (~7.2k tokens)
- [tour](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/tour.tsx): Guided tour over a region. (~9.8k tokens)

## Navigation

- [breadcrumbs](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/breadcrumbs.tsx): Trail of links to the current page (the last item, marked aria-current). (~6.2k tokens)
- [collapsible-sidebar](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/collapsible-sidebar.tsx): Collapsible sidebar from @lyndon/ui. (~17.9k tokens)
- [mega-menu](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/mega-menu.tsx): Site header whose menus share one panel. (~10.6k tokens)
- [mobile-tab-bar](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/mobile-tab-bar.tsx): Bottom tab bar for phone layouts (grows by the bottom safe area on notched phones): an accent line slides to the active tab, its icon bounces, count badges pop out when cleared, and an optional raised centre button (`onAction`) sits in the middle. (~7.0k tokens)
- [nav-list](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/nav-list.tsx): Vertical nav (sidebars, settings sections). (~2.4k tokens)
- [pagination](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/pagination.tsx): Page numbers with ellipses: 1 … 4 5 6 … 20. (~3.8k tokens)
- [steps](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/steps.tsx): Wizard progress: done steps fill, connecting lines draw across. (~2.9k tokens)
- [tabs](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/tabs.tsx): Underline travels to the clicked tab; panel fades in. (~9.8k tokens)
- [toggle](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/toggle.tsx): A two-state button (aria-pressed): bold, mute, pin. (~3.2k tokens)
- [toggle-group](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/toggle-group.tsx): Toggle buttons sharing one value (single, a radio group) or a set (multiple). (~6.3k tokens)
- [toolbar](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/toolbar.tsx): Toolbar and its parts. (~9.6k tokens)
- [wizard](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/wizard.tsx): Steps plus the current step's description and Back / Continue buttons. (~10.0k tokens)

- [banner](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/banner.tsx): Dismissible banner. (~10.1k tokens)
- [collapse](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/collapse.tsx): Animated height. (~1.0k tokens)
- [copy-button](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/copy-button.tsx): Copies `text`. (~6.9k tokens)
- [empty-state](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/empty-state.tsx): Centred icon, title, hint and action. (~2.0k tokens)
- [hold-to-confirm](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/hold-to-confirm.tsx): Press and hold (pointer, touch, Space or Enter) to confirm a destructive action. (~9.7k tokens)
- [like-button](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/like-button.tsx): Heart that bursts on like, with a rolling count. (~7.3k tokens)
- [offline-indicator](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/offline-indicator.tsx): Connection bar for the top of a view. (~8.2k tokens)
- [progress](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/progress.tsx): Linear progress bar; the fill springs to each new value. (~3.8k tokens)
- [toast](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/toast.tsx): Hosts its own toasts for the tree inside it. (~8.9k tokens)
- [typing-dots](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/typing-dots.tsx): Three bouncing dots: someone (the assistant, a teammate) is typing. (~2.1k tokens)

## Data display

- [accordion](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/accordion.tsx): Accordion: panels grow to their content height and the chevron rotates. (~6.0k tokens)
- [animated-list](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/animated-list.tsx): Any list whose items animate in, out and into new positions. (~2.2k tokens)
- [data-grid](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/data-grid.tsx): Data grid, generic over the row type, from a few rows to 100k (rows are virtualised above 100: only the ones in view are in the DOM). (~67.8k tokens)
- [data-table](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/data-table.tsx): Sortable table; rows slide to their new position when the order changes. (~3.2k tokens)
- [json-viewer](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/json-viewer.tsx): JSON tree with typed colours (strings, numbers, booleans, null). (~14.8k tokens)
- [shortcut-sheet](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/shortcut-sheet.tsx): Keyboard shortcuts in titled groups (General / Navigation / Editing…). (~15.5k tokens)
- [stat](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/stat.tsx): KPI tile: label, a ▲ / ▼ delta pill tinted by whether the change is good, a rolling value and an area sparkline along the bottom. (~6.5k tokens)
- [task-list](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/task-list.tsx): To-do list built on AnimatedList: type and press Enter (or Add) to add, an empty submit shakes the input, ticking an item draws the check and strikes the text through, ✕ slides it out while the rest close up. (~11.4k tokens)
- [virtual-list](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/virtual-list.tsx): A scrolling list that renders only the items in view. (~9.8k tokens)

## Layout

- [kanban](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/kanban.tsx): Board with rich cards. (~30.5k tokens)
- [sortable-list](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/sortable-list.tsx): Reorderable list. (~13.3k tokens)

- [tree-view](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/tree-view.tsx): File tree with roving focus: ↑ / ↓ move, → opens or steps into a folder, ← closes or jumps to the parent, Home / End jump, Enter opens (folders toggle, files call `onOpen`). (~18.9k tokens)

## Editors and content

- [address-autocomplete](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/address-autocomplete.tsx): Address search over `addresses` (your data or a geocoder's results): after 2 characters it lists up to five matches (the typed part bolded, city and country beside it). (~22.0k tokens)
- [emoji-input](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/emoji-input.tsx): Text field with an emoji button: the picker inserts at the caret and remembers recent picks, and every pick also adds a reaction chip with a count below (click a chip to take one back). (~12.9k tokens)
- [emoji-picker](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/emoji-picker.tsx): Emoji panel: category tabs, a search field (shows "N results" or an empty state), a Recent row, and an 8-column grid you can walk with the arrow keys. (~8.9k tokens)
- [markdown](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/markdown.tsx): Markdown for model output (GFM subset: headings, emphasis, strikethrough, code, fences (plain, or `renderCode`), quotes, nested and task lists, tables, rules, links, autolinks, hard breaks, `[n]` citations). (~24.5k tokens)
- [mentions-input](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/mentions-input.tsx): Message box with `@` mentions and `/` commands. (~27.6k tokens)
- [rich-text-editor](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/rich-text-editor.tsx): Rich text editor on contentEditable. (~14.7k tokens)
- [signature-pad](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/signature-pad.tsx): Signature pad on a canvas. (~10.8k tokens)
- [unsaved-changes-bar](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/unsaved-changes-bar.tsx): Save bar for a form with unsaved changes: slides up inside its (relative, overflow-hidden) container while `open`. (~9.4k tokens)

## Scheduling

- [org-chart](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/org-chart.tsx): Hierarchy laid out as a tidy tree in a fixed-height canvas that scrolls inside (the page never moves). (~15.3k tokens)
- [scheduler](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/scheduler.tsx): Calendar with Day, Week, Month and Year views (plus 3-day on phones). (~32.6k tokens)

## Code

- [code-block](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/code-block.tsx): Code block: file name with icon, language badge, line numbers, highlighted lines, wrap toggle and copy. (~15.0k tokens)
- [code-tabs](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/code-tabs.tsx): The same example in several languages. (~15.6k tokens)
- [diff](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/diff.tsx): Diff computed from `before` and `after` text (LCS line diff). (~18.6k tokens)
- [install-command](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/install-command.tsx): Install command with package-manager tabs (sliding underline) and a Copy → Copied button. (~15.3k tokens)
- [terminal](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/terminal.tsx): Terminal: commands type out character by character, output streams in, then a prompt waits with a blinking cursor (paused off screen, steady under reduced motion). (~10.4k tokens)

## Media

- [audio-player](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/audio-player.tsx): Audio player: cover, title, back / forward 10 s, speed cycle and a waveform you click or drag to seek (hovering previews the jump; on touch, tap or swipe sideways along it, while a vertical swipe still scrolls the page). (~23.9k tokens)
- [avatar-cropper](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/avatar-cropper.tsx): Avatar cropper: the photo sits under a circular mask; drag (or arrow keys) to reposition, clamped so the circle stays covered; zoom with the slider, the wheel, a two-finger pinch or + / −. (~21.9k tokens)
- [carousel](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/carousel.tsx): Scroll-snap carousel with arrows, dots, swipe and ← / → (all wrap around). (~7.6k tokens)
- [image-compare](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/image-compare.tsx): Before / after comparison: drag anywhere (or arrow keys / Home / End on the handle). (~7.7k tokens)
- [lightbox](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/lightbox.tsx): Full-screen image viewer. (~15.8k tokens)
- [masonry-gallery](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/masonry-gallery.tsx): Pinterest-style masonry: each tile drops into the shortest column; columns follow the width (two on phones). (~21.4k tokens)
- [media-card](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/media-card.tsx): Article / video card: image with a tag and duration badge, date line, title, description, author and a bookmark toggle. (~12.1k tokens)
- [mini-audio-player](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/mini-audio-player.tsx): Slim pill player: play, title, a thin draggable progress bar (← / → when focused; a 32px touch band on phones) and the time. (~15.9k tokens)
- [progressive-image](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/progressive-image.tsx): Image that blurs up: a tiny placeholder shows blurred, then the full image crossfades in. (~9.5k tokens)
- [video-player](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/video-player.tsx): Video player with custom controls: big play button, title that fades while playing, seek bar with buffer, hover time and drag, back 5 s, mute + volume, time, speed cycle and fullscreen. (~32.2k tokens)
- [voice-note](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/voice-note.tsx): Chat-style voice note bubble: play, a waveform you tap or drag to seek, elapsed / total time and a speed chip. (~16.7k tokens)
- [waveform](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/waveform.tsx): Waveform bars from `peaks` (0..1 each). (~1.2k tokens)

## Collaboration

- [anchored-comments](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/anchored-comments.tsx): Comments anchored to highlighted text: the document sits on the left, threads on the right. (~17.9k tokens)
- [chat-inbox](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/chat-inbox.tsx): Three-pane chat inbox: searchable conversation list (unread counts, online dots, last-message time), the thread (day divider, bubbles, typing indicator, simulated replies) and a details pane (role, location, live local time, shared files). (~17.3k tokens)
- [comment-thread](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/comment-thread.tsx): Threaded comments with inline reply boxes. (~11.6k tokens)
- [live-presence](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/live-presence.tsx): Live presence on a mock document: collaborators' cursors drift about with name labels, your own "You" cursor follows the pointer inside the canvas, and an avatar stack ringed in each person's colour counts who's here. (~8.5k tokens)

## Pages

- [settings-page](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/settings-page.tsx): Settings page: section nav at the start (pill slides; ↑/↓, Home/End move between sections), the panel slides in from the direction you moved. (~31.4k tokens)

## Charts

- [bar-list](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/bar-list.tsx): Ranked horizontal bars: top pages, countries, referrers. (~8.9k tokens)
- [box-violin-chart](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/box-violin-chart.tsx): Distributions per group: box (median, quartiles, 1.5 × IQR whiskers), KDE violin, or both, with outliers as dots. (~13.2k tokens)
- [bullet-chart](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/bullet-chart.tsx): Bullet chart: qualitative bands, the actual bar (green when it meets its target, neutral grey when not) and a target tick, one row per measure. (~10.9k tokens)
- [calendar-heatmap](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/calendar-heatmap.tsx): GitHub-style contribution grid in 4 levels with a Less → More legend. (~11.3k tokens)
- [chart](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/chart.tsx): The cartesian chart. (~25.8k tokens)
- [density-histogram](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/density-histogram.tsx): Histogram with a kernel-density curve, mean (dashed), median and a ±1σ shaded band. (~12.7k tokens)
- [donut-chart](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/donut-chart.tsx): Share of a total. (~11.9k tokens)
- [forest-plot](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/forest-plot.tsx): Forest plot: effect sizes with 95% CI whiskers, squares sized by inverse-variance weight, a pooled diamond and a zero line. (~12.5k tokens)
- [funnel-chart](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/funnel-chart.tsx): Funnel with step-to-step conversion. (~10.6k tokens)
- [gauge](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/gauge.tsx): Half-circle gauge. (~8.0k tokens)
- [heatmap](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/heatmap.tsx): Matrix heatmap: rows × columns. (~10.3k tokens)
- [radar-chart](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/radar-chart.tsx): Radar / spider chart for comparing a few profiles across the same axes. (~11.0k tokens)
- [regression-chart](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/regression-chart.tsx): Scatter with a least-squares fit, the 95% confidence band for the mean and (optionally) the wider 95% prediction interval. (~12.5k tokens)
- [scatter-chart](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/scatter-chart.tsx): Scatter plot; give points an `r` for a bubble chart and a `group` for colours. (~11.5k tokens)
- [spark-tile](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/spark-tile.tsx): Stat tile: label, value that rolls up when scrolled into view, and a curved area sparkline under it. (~12.9k tokens)
- [ticker-table](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/ticker-table.tsx): Live price table: symbol, name, sparkline with an end dot, rolling last price and a % change pill (up/down coloured). (~9.1k tokens)
- [treemap](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/treemap.tsx): Squarified treemap: area ∝ value. (~12.1k tokens)

## Diagrams

- [data-flow](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/data-flow.tsx): Streaming pipeline: particles leave each source at its event rate, pass through the processing engine (its stage label cycles) and fan out to destinations by share. (~29.6k tokens)
- [gantt](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/gantt.tsx): Project plan. (~30.4k tokens)
- [network-graph](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/network-graph.tsx): Force-directed graph (repulsion, springs, centring) simulated in-file. (~12.3k tokens)
- [process-flow](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/process-flow.tsx): Workflow canvas. (~16.6k tokens)
- [sankey](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/sankey.tsx): Two-column Sankey: source nodes on the left, targets on the right, ribbons sized by value with % labels. (~8.1k tokens)
- [state-diagram](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/state-diagram.tsx): Interactive UML state diagram. (~16.5k tokens)
- [state-machine](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/state-machine.tsx): Live statechart of workflow machines, switchable with a segmented control. (~25.3k tokens)
- [statechart](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/statechart.tsx): SVG statechart: composite states, states, pseudo states (initial, final, history), labelled transitions, and dots that travel along a transition (each dot calls onDone when it arrives). (~10.7k tokens)
- [trace-waterfall](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/trace-waterfall.tsx): Nested spans on one streaming timeline (agent runs, API requests, jobs). (~25.1k tokens)

## Maps

- [globe](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/globe.tsx): 3D dot globe on a canvas: land as dots, great-circle routes between hubs with travelling heads, pulsing hubs with labels. (~19.2k tokens)
- [world-map](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/world-map.tsx): World choropleth by country with a metric switch. (~34.1k tokens)

## AI

- [agent-composer](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/agent-composer.tsx): Agent composer that doubles as a control panel. (~78.8k tokens)
- [agent-plan](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/agent-plan.tsx): Plan first, then live progress. (~9.9k tokens)
- [agent-transit-map](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/agent-transit-map.tsx): Live multi-agent "transit map", driven by the same WorkflowEngine as StateMachine. (~45.0k tokens)
- [ai-canvas](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/ai-canvas.tsx): Chat on the left, a living document on the right. (~27.8k tokens)
- [ai-renderers-provider](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/ai-renderers-provider.tsx): Supplies AiRenderers to every MessageParts below it (props given to a component win). (~773 tokens)
- [ai-stream](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/ai-stream.tsx): The AI message model with parts (text, reasoning, tools, sources, files, data) and useAiChat, which streams from a ReadableStream, an AsyncIterable or an AI SDK UI message stream, with stop via AbortSignal. (~8.9k tokens)
- [approval-card](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/approval-card.tsx): An approval prompt for an action the host wants to run: the tool, a summary, recipients and arguments exactly as given (shown as data, never as markup), with Deny and Approve. (~9.8k tokens)
- [assistant-chat](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/assistant-chat.tsx): Rich assistant chat. (~51.9k tokens)
- [chat-approval](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/chat-approval.tsx): Approval answer: the drafted message with Edit, Don’t send and Send; after sending, Undo. (~10.5k tokens)
- [chat-card](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/chat-card.tsx): Card frame for a generated answer part: title, caption, optional badge on the right. (~715 tokens)
- [chat-checklist](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/chat-checklist.tsx): Checklist answer: tick items off; the count updates and confetti fires when everything is done. (~10.2k tokens)
- [chat-composer](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/chat-composer.tsx): Message box: grows with text, Enter sends (never mid IME composition), Shift+Enter adds a line. (~15.3k tokens)
- [citation](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/citation.tsx): Inline [n] citation. (~8.0k tokens)
- [confidence-field](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/confidence-field.tsx): Extracted field; only low-confidence values get flagged. (~25.6k tokens)
- [conversation](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/conversation.tsx): The scrolling message log. (~15.3k tokens)
- [ghost-text-input](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/ghost-text-input.tsx): Inline completion: the rest of the best-matching suggestion shows in grey after what you typed; Tab accepts it (with a small bump). (~6.6k tokens)
- [message](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/message.tsx): One message. (~36.9k tokens)
- [message-actions](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/message-actions.tsx): The row under an answer: "Stopped" when it was cut short, Copy (`text`, read when clicked), thumbs up / down (controlled `rating` + `onRate`, or uncontrolled), Regenerate or Retry (`onRetry`), and anything you add (`children`, e.g. (~11.0k tokens)
- [message-parts](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/message-parts.tsx): Renders a message's parts in order: text as Markdown (or through `renderers.text`; links through safeUrl, `[n]` is a Citation of the message's n-th source), reasoning as Reasoning, tool calls as ToolCard (approvals go to `onDecideTool`; data through `renderers.value`), files as attachment tiles, errors with a Retry (`onRetry`), and `data` parts through `renderData` (nothing by default). (~36.2k tokens)
- [model-comparison](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/model-comparison.tsx): Same prompt, several models streamed side by side at their own speeds: thinking dots, first-token time, tokens/s and cost. (~14.4k tokens)
- [permission-request](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/permission-request.tsx): Ask before acting: say what, to whom, and why. (~20.3k tokens)
- [prompt-input](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/prompt-input.tsx): The prompt box for chats. (~15.2k tokens)
- [reasoning](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/reasoning.tsx): Collapsible model reasoning in the ThinkingSteps style. (~7.6k tokens)
- [shimmer-text](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/shimmer-text.tsx): Text with a light sweeping across it. (~719 tokens)
- [source-list](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/source-list.tsx): Source chips under an answer: tile, title and domain, numbered, each a link when it has a `url`. (~3.4k tokens)
- [sources-panel](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/sources-panel.tsx): Answer with numbered citations next to their source cards (stacked below on phones). (~6.9k tokens)
- [streaming-text](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/streaming-text.tsx): Reveals `text` word by word (useStreamedText as a component). (~1.8k tokens)
- [suggested-edit](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/suggested-edit.tsx): Proposed rewrite. (~11.5k tokens)
- [suggestions](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/suggestions.tsx): Suggestion chips (starters, follow-ups). (~6.6k tokens)
- [thinking-steps](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/thinking-steps.tsx): Reasoning as a vertical stepper. (~10.8k tokens)
- [tool-call](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/tool-call.tsx): Collapsible tool-call row: shimmering label and spinner while running, a check and the past tense when done. (~7.4k tokens)
- [tool-card](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/tool-card.tsx): A tool call from a message: status icon, tool name and state, and (click to open) its arguments and result, as data (indented JSON, or `renderValue`, e.g. (~11.9k tokens)
- [voice-input](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/voice-input.tsx): Mic button with a live waveform. (~10.7k tokens)

## Theming

- [appearance-menu](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/appearance-menu.tsx): The appearance panel behind a gear button for your app header (the gear turns while it is open). (~39.0k tokens)
- [appearance-panel](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/appearance-panel.tsx): Everything in the appearance panel, without the popover: mode, theme families with split previews, variant chips (Ayu Mirage / Dark, Tokyo Night / Storm), a Customise grid that creates a Custom theme, corner radius, font, Reset and Copy CSS. (~33.6k tokens)
- [theme-preview](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/theme-preview.tsx): Theme thumbnail split diagonally: the light palette on the left, the chosen dark palette on the right. (~1.1k tokens)
- [theme-toggle](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/theme-toggle.tsx): One-click light/dark switch for the header. (~6.8k tokens)

## Blocks (copy-in page sections)

- [checkout](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/checkout.tsx): Checkout: Cart → Details → Payment with slide transitions, quantity steppers and an order summary whose subtotal, promo, VAT and total all roll. (~37.9k tokens)
- [cookie-consent](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/cookie-consent.tsx): Cookie banner where rejecting is as easy as accepting. (~10.4k tokens)
- [onboarding-checklist](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/onboarding-checklist.tsx): Onboarding checklist: a progress ring with the percentage, "n of 5 complete", rows you tick off (Space / Enter too) with time estimates that turn into "Done", and confetti plus a toast at 100%. (~14.5k tokens)
- [pricing-table](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/pricing-table.tsx): Pricing table: monthly/yearly toggle (yearly saves `yearlyDiscount`), rolling prices, a billing line that spells out the yearly total and saving, a highlighted plan, and included vs missing features. (~14.8k tokens)
- [profile-card](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/profile-card.tsx): Profile card: gradient cover, avatar overlapping it, Message and Follow / Following (the compact follower count rolls), a Pro badge, bio, stats and Posts / Projects / About tabs. (~17.9k tokens)

## Other

- [chart-with-journal](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/chart-with-journal.tsx): A chart and its journal side by side (pattern H), linked both ways: hovering, focusing or tapping a tag on either side lights it on the other, and the list scrolls the lit row into view without moving focus. (~23.1k tokens)
- [magnet-bubble](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/magnet-bubble.tsx): The label bubble above a thumb (the shared tooltip look). (~653 tokens)
- [magnet-marks](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/magnet-marks.tsx): The track decorations: a tick for each point (and each zone centre), a tinted band for each zone. (~1.7k tokens)
- [state-ribbon](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/state-ribbon.tsx): What you were doing all day in one strip (pattern F: sleep stages, Toggl and RescueTime day bars): contiguous states coloured by kind, optional pins above for point tags (merged into counts when crowded) and bars below for spans. (~16.5k tokens)
- [swimlanes](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/swimlanes.tsx): One lane per kind of tag on a shared time axis (pattern E: Dynatrace annotation tracks, LifeLines): dots for point tags, rounded pills for spans, an icon and label at the start of each lane, an optional chart on top (`top`) aligned to the same `start`–`end`. (~14.9k tokens)
- [tag-glyph](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/tag-glyph.tsx): A tag's icon in a coloured ring; `active` grows it with a halo, `more` adds a "+N" badge on its end side (timeTagBadge wide). (~1.1k tokens)
- [tag-journal](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/tag-journal.tsx): A time-ordered list of tags (pattern H: Oura and WHOOP journals): time, glyph, label and detail, optionally grouped by hour, virtualised so long days stay fast. (~22.5k tokens)
- [tag-tooltip](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/tag-tooltip.tsx): Tooltip body for a tag: icon and label, the time (or from–to for a span) and the detail. (~2.7k tokens)
